# Midday alert — Wed 2026-11-25 (~12:20 PM ET)

**Hot PCE + formal tariff proposal; Nasdaq −4%.**
- Oct core PCE 3.3% y/y vs 3.2% est; Dec hike bets firmed ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/market-summary/26/11/63624831/nasdaq-down-over-4-us-core-pce-prices-increase-0-3-in-october), [Radiocor](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/radiocor/finance/dettaglio/us-midday-shares-sharply-lower-after-hot-inflation-data-tariffs-nRC_25112026_1718_552422894.html?lang=en)).
- At 11:11 ET: Nasdaq −4.19%, S&P −2.78% (Radiocor). Chips lead the drop.
- Tariffs: the US formally proposed up to 20% on China, Vietnam 20%, EU/Japan/Korea 15%, and more. Semis, autos and metals are excluded. They start after hearings, January at the earliest ([Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/3fec1b0a85a0/world/china/us-proposes-new-tariffs-14-trading-partners-fight-excess-factory-capacity-2026-11-25/), [TIKR](https://www.tikr.com/blog/tariffs-strike-again-trump-announces-tariffs-up-to-20-on-china-and-the-eu-walmart-already-navigated-over-2-billion)).

**Desk:** No new longs (−4% index day rule). AI-hardware avoid holds. Retail holds (TGT, DLTR, BBY, TJX) carry tariff risk. TGT and DLTR guides include tariff refunds. No avoid change for now, since nothing takes effect before January. signals.json is unchanged.
